title: Synchronize single-image rank witnesses on a common neighbourhood
statement: Let f:X\to S be a morphism of schemes, E a finite locally free module on X, and g:T\to S. Assume the structure-sheaf adjunction unit is an isomorphism after every base change [lem-pc-module-pullback-adjunction]. If R_1(f,E,E,g) and R_1(f,E,E^\vee,g) both hold [def-sc-picard-universal-single-rank-match], then R(f,E,g) holds [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match]. Thus the ranks and neighbourhoods in the two assumptions can be synchronized; no representing scheme is asserted.

source.place: first and third proof paragraphs: the two single-image loci use the same rank of E

proof.text: For each h:T\prime\to T and t in T\prime, obtain neighbourhoods U,V with ranks r,s from the two R_1 assumptions [def-sc-picard-universal-single-rank-match]. Let W=U intersection V, which contains t. Pullback along W→U and W→V preserves finite local freeness of fixed rank. Tensor pullback composition and the pullback projection squares identify the restricted reference modules with the same pullback of E to X_W.

Apply the universal structure-sheaf unit to Spec kappa(t)→T\prime→T→S. The fibre cannot be empty, since an empty fibre has zero structure sheaf and zero direct image, whereas the unit is an isomorphism from the nonzero residue-field structure sheaf. Thus X_W has a point over t. At that point the one reference module has both ranks r and s. The stalk-finrank theorem [lem-sc-finite-locally-free-stalk-finrank] gives r=s.

After replacing s by r, the two restricted direct images and E on X_W have rank r. The neighbourhood W and this rank provide all three clauses of [def-sc-picard-universal-rank-match]. Repeat for every h and t. Empty test schemes have no points to check and rank zero requires no separate case.

lean.statement: theorem picardUniversalRankMatch_of_singleRankMatch {X S T : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (hO : ∀ {T' : Scheme.{u}} (g' : T' ⟶ S), IsIso ((Classical.choose (Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f g'))).unit.app (SheafOfModules.unit T'.ringCatSheaf))) (E : X.Modules) [E.IsFiniteLocallyFree] (g : T ⟶ S) (hE : PicardUniversalSingleRankMatch f E E g) (hdual : PicardUniversalSingleRankMatch f E (Modules.dual E) g) : PicardUniversalRankMatch f E g
